description: Rack a row of fixed-size rectangular core Spaces (length × breadth m) along a corridor band's long sides. Feed it a Corridoor output; cores stamp every length + gap along the run, flush to the corridor edge.
instructions:
Lines a corridor band with fixed-size rectangular "core" Spaces. Wire a corridor BAND (typically the Corridoor node's output) into the input: its oriented bounding box gives the run axis and width.

• length — core size ALONG the corridor run (m); breadth — size AWAY from the corridor (m).
• gap — spacing between adjacent cores along the run; margin — setback from each corridor end.
• side — stamp cores on both sides, or only the left / right of the run.
• orientation — auto uses the band's long axis; force horizontal / vertical for square-ish inputs.

Emits one rectangle Space per placed core. Typical chain: Space → Corridoor → Core Racking.
